items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Well, he used to tell me to come here, that he could get me a job.

ctx.x: So you knew him when you came to town.

Well, he used to tell me to come here, that he could get me a job. You know what I mean? He said you could play around in Washington. And the job we had in Portsmouth folded up, so I came here -- me and Red and Bill and myself, we came here. So I got here, and a guy had a little band, working in... See, in them days, every club had live music. Some cats was playing with a little old band, but they were getting pretty good money.
